units.dist_pc: Planck18 comoving distance of the members median heliocentric cz (as the 2MRS layer)
units.mlum_h12: group mass from K luminosity, 1e12 h^-1 M_sun
units.sigV: LOS bi-weight velocity dispersion, km/s (>= 5 members)
units.sigP: LOS dispersion expected from the luminosity, km/s
units.hv: median heliocentric velocity of the members, km/s (the median: the Virgo nest lists two members at 45,376 and 65,081 km/s)

ref: Tully 2015, AJ 149, 171 (2MASS group catalogue), VizieR J/AJ/149/171
